tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App background behind cards and panels. Cool paper, leaning toward the brand blue.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tiles, sheets, list rows. Text on it uses ink and ink-muted.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Wells inside a surface: timeline track, empty calendar days, avatar ground, disabled controls.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders. Decorative only; never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of controls (inputs, secondary buttons). Holds 3:1 on surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, surface and sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, units, axis labels on bg, surface and sunken. Never below 12px.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Primary actions, focus ring, links. Also the owner voice: anything the owner set by hand is blue.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of the primary button.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Selected nav item, owner-edit stamp ground, selected row.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand-tint, and quiet buttons on surface.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text on a brand fill.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, drawn 3px solid with a 2px offset on every interactive element.

tokens.name: in
tokens.usage: Currently clocked in, and nothing else. Tile border, timeline segment, solid dots.

tokens.name: in-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of the In stamp, a full day cell, a clocked-in tile ring.

tokens.name: in-ink
tokens.usage: Text on in-tint.

tokens.name: attention
tokens.usage: Needs a look but pay is not wrong yet: missing clock-out, check punches, half day, syncing.

tokens.name: attention-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of attention stamps, callouts and day cells.

tokens.name: attention-ink
tokens.usage: Text on attention-tint.

tokens.name: attention-wash
tokens.usage: Ground of a large attention block (callout, banner, selected row). Lighter than attention-tint so a block does not shout; the stamp and the edge carry the signal.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: Something is wrong or someone is missing: absent, payment mismatch, destructive actions.

tokens.name: alert-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of alert stamps, callouts and day cells.

tokens.name: alert-ink
tokens.usage: Text on alert-tint.

tokens.name: alert-wash
tokens.usage: Ground of a large alert block (callout, mismatch row, field in error). Lighter than alert-tint so a block does not shout; the stamp and the edge carry the signal.

tokens.name: holiday
tokens.usage: Paid weekly holiday. The only use of violet.

tokens.name: holiday-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of the Holiday stamp and holiday day cells.

tokens.name: holiday-ink
tokens.usage: Text on holiday-tint.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: clock
styles.usage: The kiosk clock. One per screen.

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Panel titles and employee names on a tile.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: No clock-out tap. The system closed it at 12:00 AM.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body text and button labels.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, nav labels, table headers.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: The smallest text allowed. Helper text, timestamps in lists.

styles.name: time
styles.usage: Every punch time, duration and money amount in a list. Tabular by nature.

styles.name: time-large
styles.usage: The time on a punch confirmation and a session card.

styles.name: stamp
styles.usage: Text inside a Stamp. Always uppercase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, stamp padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding, gap inside a card.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, page gutter on a phone.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between cards, page gutter on a tablet.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Kiosk panel padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Largest layout step.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Stamps, day cells, timeline segments: anything that should read as a printed mark.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, avatars, list rows.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and employee tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Sheets, dialogs and the punch confirmation.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Cards and employee tiles at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Sheets, dialogs and popovers only.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of any control on admin screens.

tokens.name: tap-kiosk
tokens.usage: Minimum height of any control on the kiosk, used with gloves or at arm length.

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: Admin navigation rail from 900px up.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of admin page content.
